Given:
1. Q
.2. ¬¬P
.What can we conclude from the above statements?

When you are done, put your final answer between <answer> and </answer> tags.

message.content:

1. Q
2. ¬¬P (not-not P)

In classical propositional logic, double negation can be eliminated: from ¬¬P we may conclude P (since ¬¬P is equivalent to P). The premise Q is already given, so the new conclusion derivable from the premises is **P**.

<answer>P</answer>
